sections.content: When reporting information, Spanish commonly uses expressions such as *según*, informar de *que* and decir que. The speaker should distinguish the source of the information from their own interpretation. At B1, the priority is to report what a source says clearly and accurately, without adding unsupported details.

items.spanish: Según la fuente oficial, el suceso ocurrió durante la noche.
items.english: According to the official source, the incident happened during the night.

items.spanish: La televisión informó de que varias personas habían visto una luz extraña.
items.english: Television reported that several people had seen a strange light.

items.spanish: La noticia explica que los investigadores todavía no tienen una respuesta.
items.english: The news report explains that the investigators still do not have an answer.

items.spanish: Según los testigos, el objeto apareció durante unos minutos y después desapareció.
items.english: According to witnesses, the object appeared for a few minutes and then disappeared.

sections.content: Use a clear source marker such as *según* + source when you want to separate reported information from your own interpretation.
